app.tagline: Connect your Phantom board and your Twitch account for interactive games with your community

voteOptions.title: Voting System
voteOptions.majorityHint: If disabled, the wheel decides randomly

twitchOptions.hint: Mods, VIPs, and broadcaster always allowed

game.replaceConfirm: A game is in progress: replace it with the new one?

games.inprogress_description: Join a Twitch Battle or watch as spectator

myphantomPreview.title: Shared Phantom
myphantomPreview.description: Use the shared Phantom to try without owning one!

presets.rushCard: Your chat solves puzzle after puzzle
presets.followersHint: Followers only: only followers, subs, mods and VIPs can register. Twitch will ask once for permission to read your followers.

rushPage.desc: Your chat solves harder and harder puzzles. Three mistakes and the run is over.
rushPage.modeHint: Unlimited: the first valid move suggested by chat is played. Each time has its own leaderboard.

mono.desc: Your chat has 2 minutes to register by typing join, then the game starts.
mono.vsStreamerDesc: You play on the board, registered viewers vote for the other side.
mono.teamsDesc: Registered viewers are randomly split into two teams, White and Black.

multi.desc: Two channels face off. Once both streamers are on the link, their chats have 2 minutes to register.
multi.invalidOpponent: Enter the other channel's Twitch name
multi.loginRequired: Log in with Twitch to enter this game.
multi.followersScope: This game is for followers only: log in again to allow reading them.
multi.waitingHint: Send them this link: the 2 minutes of registration start once you are both here.
multi.partnerLeft: Connection with the other channel was lost, the game is interrupted.

denied.invalid: This game link is not valid.
denied.auth: Your Twitch session has expired, please log in again.
denied.notParticipant: This link is reserved for {a} and {b}.
denied.playing: This game is already in progress.

lobby.title: Registration open
lobby.hint: Type join in chat to play
lobby.hintFollowers: Type join in chat to play (followers only)
lobby.hintSubs: Type join in chat to play (subs only)
lobby.followCheckFailed: Twitch is not responding: registrations go through without a follow check.
lobby.nobodyYet: At least one player must register to start the game.

roster.title: Registered players
roster.lateJoinHint: Chat can type join at any time, even during the game.

setup.phantomHint: Connect the Phantom to adjust its speed and sync.

browsePage.desc: Live games and Puzzle Rush records. To play, go to New.

tournamentFollow.title: Sync the Phantom
tournamentFollow.hint: The Phantom will set up this position, then follow the moves of the game.
